title: Suspended Loads
controls: Never work beneath suspended loads
Use designated exclusion zone
Maintain radio communication with operator and signal person

title: Falls from Height
controls: Wear and tie off 100% fall protection at 3 m or open edges
Verify anchor points rated and inspected
Maintain guardrails / leading-edge protection

title: Crush / Pinch Points
controls: Keep clear of load path and landing zones
Use tag lines — never guide with hands under load
Confirm all personnel clear before landing

title: Struck By Object
controls: Hard hat mandatory in work zone
Secure loose tools and materials at height
Establish drop zones and barricades

title: Exclusion Zone Breach
controls: Mark and enforce swing / pour exclusion zones
Spotter required for public or adjacent crews
Stop work if unauthorized entry occurs

title: Blind Lift / Limited Visibility
controls: Dedicated signal person with clear radio channel
Confirm line-of-sight plan before lift
Operator stops on lost communication

title: Radio / Communication Failure
controls: Pre-check radios on assigned channel
Use standard hand signals as backup
Abort lift if communication lost

title: Rigging Failure
controls: Inspect slings, shackles, and hardware before each lift
Verify WLL and hitch configuration
Remove damaged gear from service immediately

title: Load Swing / Uncontrolled Movement
controls: Use tag lines on free ends
Monitor wind and boom / jib movement
Do not side-load or snatch loads

title: High Wind
controls: Check anemometer / site wind limits before lift
Suspend panel flying and fly table moves in high wind
Secure loose materials and weathervane crane as required

title: Overhead Powerlines
controls: Maintain minimum approach distances
Use spotter for all boom / load movement near lines
Confirm de-energize / insulating measures if required

title: Crane Tip / Outrigger Failure
controls: Verify ground bearing and outrigger pads
Stay within load chart for radius and configuration
Level crane before lifting

title: Personnel Platform Hazards
controls: Platform inspected and certified for use
Occupants wear fall protection tied to platform
No free-fall or sudden movements — trial lift required

title: Concrete Spill / Splash
controls: Confirm bucket gate and seals before lift
Clear landing area and wear eye / skin protection
Wash stations available for concrete exposure

title: Concrete / Chemical Exposure
controls: Wear gloves, boots, and eye protection
Rinse skin immediately on contact
Review SDS for admixtures in use

title: Slips on Wet / Slick Surfaces
controls: Clean pour residue promptly
Use anti-slip footwear
Barricade wet areas until safe

title: Electrical Hazards
controls: GFCI on all temporary power
Inspect cords and tools before use
Keep electrical clear of wet pour areas

title: Hand-Arm Vibration
controls: Rotate operators on vibrator duty
Use anti-vibration gloves where practical
Report numbness or tingling immediately

title: High Noise
controls: Hearing protection required near vibrators and generators
Limit exposure duration
Use hand signals in high-noise zones

title: Pinch Points — Forms & Hardware
controls: Keep hands clear of closing forms and clamps
Use proper tools for wedge and pin removal
Coordinate stripping sequence with crew

title: Musculoskeletal Strain
controls: Team lift heavy panels and materials
Use mechanical aids where available
Stretch and rotate tasks

title: Trips / Poor Housekeeping
controls: Keep walkways clear of debris and rebar
Stage materials in designated areas only
Address hazards immediately — don't walk by

title: Sharp Edges / Cuts
controls: Wear cut-resistant gloves when handling form hardware
Cap protruding rebar and pins
Dispose of scrap in designated bins

title: Ladder Use
controls: Select correct ladder type and duty rating
Inspect before use — remove defective ladders
Secure ladder and maintain three-point contact

title: Scaffold Collapse / Instability
controls: Only use tagged and inspected scaffold
Do not overload or modify without authorization
Report damaged components immediately

title: Mechanical Failure
controls: Complete daily inspection checklist before operation
Report unusual noises, leaks, or alarms
Do not operate equipment with unresolved deficiencies

title: Crane / Structure Collision
controls: Know slew limits and nearby structures
Use cameras / spotters in congested zones
Slow and deliberate movements near obstacles

title: Lockout / Tagout
controls: Apply LOTO before maintenance
Verify zero energy state
Only authorized workers remove locks
